name: When is it better to replace an entire fence section rather than just repairing posts?

mainEntity.name: When is it better to replace an entire fence section rather than just repairing posts?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is better to replace an entire fence section rather than just repairing individual posts when multiple posts are severely damaged, or the fence panels themselves are deteriorating. If the overall integrity of a section is compromised due to widespread rot, insect damage, or structural failure in several components, a full section replacement provides a more uniform and long-lasting solution than piecemeal repairs. This decision is often a practical tradeoff between numerous small repairs that may not fully address underlying issues versus a comprehensive, albeit more involved, replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace an entire fence section when multiple posts are severely damaged or panels are deteriorating. This offers a more uniform and lasting solution than piecemeal repairs.
